name: dsh-shell-remote
description: dsh-shell-remote: one-shot remote shell execution over system OpenSSH (`ssh <host> -- bash -c <cmd>`), forked from the dsh-shell-host type vocabulary (ADR-0001 descriptor words, ADR-0004 decisions 1-5). ShellResult stays field-identical to @deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-local (D8); all path semantics are REMOTE paths; spill-class host capabilities loudly reject.
